reports.title: Pony AI Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results:

desk.headline: Revenue up 75% to $44.6m, beat; 2026 robotaxi fleet and revenue targets reaffirmed
results: Revenue rose 75% to $44.6m; robotaxi revenue jumped 165% to $17.8m and is now about 40% of the total, with paid-ride fares up nearly 400%.
Robotruck revenue grew 76% to $18.0m on freight work; intelligent solutions were roughly flat at $8.9m.
Operating loss edged down to $68.7m, and the non-GAAP operating loss fell 8% to $58.3m as costs held flat.
Net loss widened to $136.3m ($0.24 a share) due to a $77.0m fair-value loss on trading securities.
Cash and investments were $1.15bn at quarter-end, down from $1.21bn in June.

guidance.summary: No revenue or earnings range is given. Management said it remains on track for its 2026 goals: 3,500 robotaxis in 20 cities by year-end and robotaxi revenue of 3.5 times the 2025 level.

points: Fleets in Guangzhou and Shenzhen are already making a positive margin per vehicle, though no figure was given.
Insurance on Gen-7 robotaxis has fallen to about 40% of a human-driven taxi's, down from about 50% in 2025.
Overseas expansion uses partners to supply depots and maintenance; Zagreb is driverless and Manchester road tests have begun.
Robotrucks are in service at two Guangdong ports, with hundreds of vehicles targeted across ports next year.
Management said it is not short of computing power despite chip export limits and will keep spending tight.
call.source: Q3 2026 call transcript — The Motley Fool, 18 Nov 2026

watch: Whether the fleet reaches 3,500 vehicles in 20 cities by year-end.
Progress on European launches, including London and Manchester.
Cash burn against the $1.15bn of cash and investments.
